monte_carlo.label: Monte Carlo
monte_carlo.measures: Runs 10,000 simulated futures of the next 7 trading days using the stock's recent price behavior.
monte_carlo.scoreRange: Higher score = more simulations finish above today's price. 50 = roughly even odds.
monte_carlo.whyMatters: Reduces a noisy short-term forecast into a single probability. The most forward-looking signal in the ensemble.

momentum.label: Momentum
momentum.measures: How fast the price has been moving over the last 5 and 20 trading days.
momentum.scoreRange: 0–40 = falling. 50 = flat. 60–100 = rising. The further from 50, the stronger the move.
momentum.whyMatters: Catches stocks that are already moving in your direction. Best on liquid, trending names.

volume.label: Volume Confirmation
volume.measures: Whether recent price moves are backed by above-average trading volume.
volume.scoreRange: High score = move is confirmed by volume (real). Low score = move is on thin volume (fragile).
volume.whyMatters: A breakout without volume usually fails. This engine filters out fake moves.

support_resistance.label: Support / Resistance
support_resistance.measures: Distance from the nearest historical support floor and resistance ceiling.
support_resistance.scoreRange: High score = near support with room to rally. Low score = near resistance with limited upside.
support_resistance.whyMatters: Defines the risk/reward of a trade. Helps set stops and targets at meaningful price levels.

mean_reversion.label: Mean Reversion
mean_reversion.measures: How far today's price has stretched away from the 50-day moving average.
mean_reversion.scoreRange: High score = stretched below average (bounce setup). Low score = stretched above (pullback risk).
mean_reversion.whyMatters: Identifies overextended moves likely to snap back. The opposite-but-complementary signal to Momentum.

bollinger.label: Bollinger Bands
bollinger.measures: Whether the bands are squeezed (quiet) or expanding (breakout in progress).
bollinger.scoreRange: High score = breakout direction confirmed. Mid score = squeeze (big move soon, direction unclear).
bollinger.whyMatters: Signals the start of a new trend. Squeeze setups precede the largest moves.

correlation.label: Sector Correlation
correlation.measures: Whether sector peers are moving in the same direction as this stock.
correlation.scoreRange: High score = sector confirms the move (not a one-off). Low score = lone wolf — be cautious.
correlation.whyMatters: A signal confirmed by peers is more durable than an isolated move that may reverse quickly.

rsi.label: RSI
rsi.measures: Whether recent gains have left the stock overbought, or recent losses have left it oversold (RSI-14).
rsi.scoreRange: 0–30: bullish (oversold rebound setup). 70–100: bearish (overbought pullback risk). 40–60: neutral.
rsi.whyMatters: Catches stretched moves that often snap back. Most useful as a contrarian filter on top of trend signals.

macd.label: MACD
macd.measures: Whether the short-term moving average has crossed above or below the long-term one (12/26/9).
macd.scoreRange: High score = bullish crossover with momentum. Low score = bearish crossover. A fresh crossover boosts the score.
macd.whyMatters: Classic trend-change confirmation. Pairs well with momentum to confirm a real shift in direction.

volatility_regime.label: Volatility Regime
volatility_regime.measures: How turbulent the stock is right now compared with its own trailing 1-year history.
volatility_regime.scoreRange: Reports a tag (calm / normal / elevated / extreme). Does not vote — instead it dampens the combined score in elevated and extreme regimes.
volatility_regime.whyMatters: Engine signals are less reliable in chaotic markets. This engine pulls the combined score toward neutral when conditions are unstable.
